source_resources.title: The Turing Way: A Handbook for Reproducible, Ethical and Collaborative Data Science
source_resources.author: The Turing Way Community
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external reference under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; only links and original explanations are used.
source_resources.prerequisites: Basic version control and command-line familiarity.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Community-maintained CC-BY handbook codifying reproducibility checklists (versioned code, environment capture, rerunnable commands); directly defines the Day 90 reproduction-verification and provenance-audit workflow.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Freely hosted online; Netlify mirror availability is not guaranteed offline.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The portfolio checklist and verification log schema are authored locally; reproduction commands run without the handbook.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Wilson et al. Good enough practices in scientific computing (PLOS CB 2017)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Concise practices paper; The Turing Way's maintained, checklist-driven coverage of environments and reproducibility is broader and kept current.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Sandve et al. Ten Simple Rules for Reproducible Computational Research (PLOS CB 2013)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Foundational rules list; The Turing Way expands the same rules into actionable checklists used verbatim for the Day 90 verification run.

source_resources.title: Model Cards for Model Reporting
source_resources.author: Margaret Mitchell, Simone Wu, Andrew Zaldivar, Parker Barnes, Lucy Vasserman, Ben Hutchinson, Elena Spitzer, Inioluwa Deborah Raji, Timnit Gebru
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic citation of AI transparency standard.
source_resources.prerequisites: Evaluation reporting, demographic and performance slicing, model limitations and caveats.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary standard for structured, transparent model reporting, mandating explicit disclosure of intended uses, evaluation slices, out-of-scope tasks, ethical considerations, and negative results.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Complete Model Card Markdown templates, section schemas, and evaluation disclosure checklists are provided in the curriculum.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Bommasani et al. The Foundation Model Transparency Index
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Corporate transparency audit index; Mitchell et al. provides the concrete technical artifact specification for individual model releases.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Pushkarna et al. Data Cards: Purposeful and Transparent Dataset Documentation for Responsible AI
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Dataset documentation focus; Mitchell et al. provides the required specification for trained model artifact reporting.

source_resources.title: Datasheets for Datasets
source_resources.author: Timnit Gebru, Jamie Morgenstern, Briana Vecchione, Jennifer Wortman Vaughan, Hanna Wallach, Hal Daumé III, Kate Crawford
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic citation of dataset governance literature.
source_resources.prerequisites: Dataset provenance, curation motivation, preprocessing transparency, maintenance lifecycle.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Foundational literature introducing standardized documentation for machine learning datasets, specifying questions on dataset composition, collection mechanisms, preprocessing, and distribution rights.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Freely available on arXiv and ACM.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Datasheet questionnaires, provenance schemas, and dataset auditing checklists are completely integrated into lesson materials.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Bender & Friedman. Data Statements for Natural Language Processing: Toward Mitigating System Bias and Enabling Better Science
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Linguistic demographic documentation focus; Gebru et al. provides the universal engineering datasheet framework adopted across AI.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Holland et al. The Dataset Nutrition Label: A Framework to Drive Higher Data Quality Standards
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Nutrition label metaphor; Gebru et al. is a widely cited framework for dataset documentation in both academic and industrial practice.

source_resources.title: PyTorch Tutorial: Saving and Loading Models
source_resources.author: PyTorch Documentation Team
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external reference under BSD open source documentation license.
source_resources.prerequisites: Python, PyTorch tensors and nn.Module basics.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Official documentation detailing state_dict serialization, optimizer state saving, and safe loading patterns.
source_resources.safe_fallback: All checkpoint serialization semantics, dictionary schema keys, and safe recovery steps are self-contained in lesson code.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: TensorFlow trackable checkpoint architecture; PyTorch's explicit dictionary is our target implementation standard.
Safetensors provides safe zero-copy tensor storage without pickle, compared directly when discussing pickle execution risks.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Saving & Loading a General Checkpoint for Inference and/or Resuming Training

source_resources.title: Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques: Promising Directions From Cognitive and Educational Psychology
source_resources.author: John Dunlosky, Katherine A. Rawson, Elizabeth J. Marsh, Mitchell J. Nathan, Daniel T. Willingham
source_resources.version_or_verification_date: Psychological Science in the Public Interest, 2013 (Verified: 2026-10-30)
source_resources.license: Journal publisher copyright (all rights reserved) - lawful external linking only
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external citation of the publisher record; no text imported into curriculum materials.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Detailed comparative review rating practice testing and distributed practice as high-utility techniques while rating highlighting and rereading low-utility; anchors the retrieval, correction, and spaced-review design of Days 88-90.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Paywalled at SAGE; author-hosted preprints exist on university sites.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Curriculum restates the utility ratings and application conditions in original prose; every task remains runnable offline.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Pashler et al. Learning Styles: Concepts and Evidence
compared_candidates.license: Publisher copyright (originally Wiley; now SAGE Publications)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Important negative result on learning-styles matching but narrower scope; Dunlosky et al. rates a broader set of techniques directly usable for this curriculum.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Brown, Roediger & McDaniel: Make It Stick: The Science of Successful Learning
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Strong trade-book synthesis of the same evidence base; the peer-reviewed review is preferred for citation precision and technique-by-technique utility ratings.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Psychological Science in the Public Interest 14(1): 4-58; practice testing and distributed practice sections

source_resources.title: Dive into Deep Learning (d2l.ai)
source_resources.author: Aston Zhang, Zachary C. Lipton, Mu Li, Alexander J. Smola
source_resources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (book text) / modified MIT (sample code)
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external linking under CC BY-SA 4.0 (book text; sample code under a modified MIT license); share-alike conditions are retained separately and no source text is imported.
source_resources.prerequisites: Linear algebra, calculus, and probability at the Days 19-28 level.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary open reference tying evaluation discipline (model selection, underfitting, overfitting) and optimization algorithms (gradient descent, minibatch) to the rest of the curriculum.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Free web book at d2l.ai; Jupyter source notebooks are on GitHub.
source_resources.safe_fallback: All required formulas and worked numbers are reproduced as original explanations; the book is further reading.

compared_candidates.license: MIT Press; free HTML for reading, all rights reserved
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Detailed treatment of optimization difficulties (chapter 8) including saddle points and plateaus; all-rights-reserved text kept as a linking-only alternative.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: fast.ai: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Strong practitioner framing, but organized around the fastai library and video lessons rather than self-contained mathematics.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Section: Model Selection, Underfitting, and Overfitting; Chapter: Optimization Algorithms
